scope: Silent A10; all held-out runs; act1 primary, act2/3 secondary
arms: Jev same facts + 5 cases + per-option observational statistics
case_ranking: same act/ascension; 2*deck multiset Jaccard + option Jaccard + same Boss + same HP quartile; latest tie-break; distinct runs
pilot: 6 evenly spaced test questions, both arms; no tuning from accuracy
network: Nova only; key file; no redirect, no retry, 20s timeout, 2 worker threads
inference: Wilson intervals and 2000 run-cluster bootstrap, seed16; paired delta; errors count as disagreement
restriction: offline phase1 only; no live/shadow integration
postcombat_evidence: same run and floor COMBAT decision timestamp strictly before reward question; no reward/card-only inference
